# Humans
Depending on who you ask, humans are either unremarkable or the universal standard to which everything else is compared.
## Background
The original pioneers of the universe; or at least that’s what they’ve always claimed. From the earliest days of spacefaring, your kind has carried the ambition and drive of explorers unmatched by any other species. Every planet colonized, every star system surveyed, has been proof of your belief that the universe itself can and should be shaped by your hands.
You’ve been the dominant species in the galaxy ever since your kind first began their ascent beyond Earth, and there is no intention of stopping at your own sector. Humanity’s expansion is relentless, fueled by a mixture of curiosity, necessity, and ambition. Across countless colonies, corporate space stations, and research outposts, human influence spreads like a living network. The Sol Alliance, a militaristic, authoritarian regime born from the heart of the Solar System, is the origin for most humans. You’re built by discipline, strategy, and an unwavering belief in the right to lead.
You’re a species that leaves its mark wherever it goes. From distant asteroid settlements to massive orbital cities, you were born to expand across the galaxy. Diplomacy, trade, or outright conflict: humans approach all interactions with the same intensity and drive that brought them to the stars in the first place.
## Benefits - They interact [color=#1e90ff]about 20% faster[/color] compared to other species.
## Drawbacks - None!
